text:
lina (prod): quick list of tiny compliance-panel nits from design review. want to lock down copy + a11y + a tiny flow for BYOK before we cut the RC.

omar (frontend): paste of current audit event i can grep?

lina (prod): current audit example: `User updated retention to 90`  missing units and actor placement. propose friendly: `Retention changed from 30 days to 90 days by alex (UI)`. compact table variant: `Retention: 30d  90d — alex (UI)`.

chris (docs): sentence form is best for search and docs. please keep actor+method in text. we'll map structured fields in the export.

ravi (security): backend will keep actor/method/resource_id separately. also add `severity=warning` for destructive changes (retention shrink, enable BYOK). UI should surface a small warning chip on those rows.

maya (a11y): accessibility nit — retention select currently shows `30 60 90` with no units. SRs read numbers only. update visible options to `30 days`, `60 days`, `90 days` and give compact table `30d` with `aria-label="30 days"`. add `aria-label="Data retention period"` to the select.

omar (frontend): easy change, will add i18n keys `retention.expanded.30=\"30 days\"` and `retention.compact.30=\"30d\"`. will wire aria-label to expanded key.

lina (prod): KMS badge confusion: customers misread `KMS`. proposal: table pill `Encrypted (Platform)` vs `Encrypted (BYOK)`. detail view: `Platform-managed key` / `Customer-managed key (Bring Your Own Key)` + link `Learn about key ownership`.

ravi (security): BYOK enable must show modal warning: `Enabling BYOK may make existing data unrecoverable if key is deleted or revoked. Org admins only.` Require checkbox `I understand BYOK responsibilities` and log `BYOKEnabled` with actor and workspace.

maya (a11y): ensure BYOK pill contrast >= 4.5:1, pill icon `aria-hidden=true`, and provide screen-reader-only text `Encryption type: Customer-managed key`. tooltip triggers must be keyboard-focusable and use `aria-describedby`.

chris (docs): audit CSV export: customers asked for structured columns: `event_type, field_changed, old_value, new_value, actor, method, resource_id, severity, timestamp, meta_json`. we'll document redaction rules.

lina (prod): region defaulting flow: product wants an org default. compromise: inline toggle `Make this the default region for new resources (Org admins only)` visible near the picker, with a `?` linking to Org Defaults. tooltip text: `Affects only new resources; existing resources unchanged.`

omar (frontend): will implement toggle visible + subdued styling; gate change to org_admin role server-side.

ravi (security): export downloads must be permissioned to org_admin/compliance only and emit `AuditExportDownloaded` event with filters. redact PII in meta_json by default.

lina (prod): final copy nit: confirmation modal when shrinking retention currently says `Are you sure?`. change to `Change retention to 90 days for Workspace X? Messages older than 90 days may be permanently deleted.` require checkbox `I understand this may permanently delete messages older than the new retention period` for destructive changes.

maya (a11y): modal must trap focus, expose checkbox label, and avoid `learn more` as lone link text. use `Learn about data lifecycle` instead.

deploy-bot: scheduled staging deploy for `compliance-panel/rc` on 2026-05-02T04:00:00Z :rocket:

lina (prod): action items: omar PR for i18n + pills + modals, ravi review export redaction + BYOK modal copy, maya a11y QA, chris update docs. i'll upload final artboard here after edits. thanks!
